mapper.select: SELECT i.insured_id, i.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, i.name, i.birth_date, i.gender, i.phone, i.relation, i.reg_date FROM insured_person i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY i.reg_date DESC

SELECT i.insured_id, i.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, i.name, i.birth_date, i.gender, i.phone, i.relation, i.reg_date FROM insured_person i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.insured_id = #{insuredId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insured_person (insured_id, customer_id, name, birth_date, gender, phone, relation) VALUES (#{insuredId}, #{customerId}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{relation})
mapper.update: UPDATE insured_person SET customer_id = #{customerId}, name = #{name}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, relation = #{relation} WHERE insured_id = #{insuredId}
